name: Leather Belt
description: A plain leather belt with iron buckle. Holds pouches and scabbards.

name: Adventurer's Belt
description: A wide belt with multiple loops and pouches for quick-draw access. Boosts the potency of all skills.

name: Ogre Girdle
description: A thick, heavy girdle fashioned from ogre leather and reinforced with iron plates. Its brutal weight grants the wearer exceptional resilience.
